name: Aerial Ambusher (Combat, Technique)
body:
By striking into an oncoming flight path, you swat into airborne targets with precise momentum.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus to melee attack rolls and weapon damage rolls against creatures in a position at least 5 feet above you or who are airborne at your same elevation or higher. If you strike a flying creature, that creature takes half the damage your attack deals as a penalty on its next Fly check before the start of its next turn (minimum 1).
